brief:
Sixteen countries have endorsed sanctions targeting Israeli settlement expansion and entities obstructing humanitarian assistance to Gaza, according to Middle East Eye. A joint statement welcomed measures against settlement companies and an Israeli settler group accused of preventing aid delivery to the territory.

The coordinated backing represents a rare multilateral response to Israeli settlement policy and alleged obstruction of humanitarian operations. The statement did not specify which nations issued the joint endorsement or detail the particular sanctions mechanisms involved.
dek: Sixteen countries back sanctions targeting Israel’s illegal settlement expansion Submitted by Elis Gjevori on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 12:14 Joint statement welcomes measures against settlement firms and an Israeli settler group blocking humanitarian aid to Gaza…
title: Sixteen nations back sanctions on Israeli settlements and aid blockers
